text: Sir, the price will rise tomorrow morning. Please send half the money to my savings account today.
My godown manager only accepts cash on pickup. Do not bother with the app, it is slow.
Everyone in your group already paid me directly. You are the last one, send it on my number now.
I need a small clearance charge from each of you before the lorry leaves. Pay it on this link.
Share the six digit code from your bank message and I will lock your cartons.
This rate is only for your group, nobody else in the market gets it. Please keep it to yourselves.
Once sold, goods cannot be returned or exchanged under any condition. Pay me by wire today.
Believe me, I have supplied to hundreds of shops and never had a problem. Transfer to my account first.
Boss, the app charges me extra. Pay my agent's UPI and I will give you two percent off.
Only a few cartons remain and a bigger buyer is calling me. Decide in the next twenty minutes.
Please type your net banking password on this page so I can verify your shop.
Aaj raat tak hi ye rate hai, kal se double. Abhi mere personal number pe paisa bhej do.
Bhai platform ke bahar dealing karte hain, tumhe discount milega, bas pehle advance de do.
Trust me, quality is guaranteed one hundred percent. Just pay a booking fee to my wallet.
We stop taking orders at midnight. Gift cards are the fastest way to confirm your slot.
Send me the card number and the three digits at the back, then we can speed up your order.
No cancellation and no money back, that is our policy. Put the amount in my bank account.
The customs officer wants a small fee before release. Send it to this number and tell nobody.
Do not tell the platform about this special price, they will take their commission. Pay me directly.
Our offer closes within the hour. Deposit the token amount to my account and I hold your stock.
I am sending a link for a faster payment page, enter your PIN there and the lorry moves.
Your group is lucky, I never do this for anyone. Quietly send the money and I will deliver tomorrow.
Last two pallets are left and the price goes up at five. Wire me the money immediately.
The escrow is not working for me. Pay by crypto instead, I will share the address.
I promise you will not regret it. Just transfer the advance to my cousin's account today.
Please pay the handling charge in cash to my driver, otherwise the order is cancelled automatically.
Mere account me abhi paisa daal do, nahi to stock kisi aur ko chala jayega.
Sirf aaj ke liye ye rate hai. Platform chhodo, direct payment karo aur screenshot bhejo.
We can fix the deal now if you send me your login for the wholesale portal.
Zero risk deal, I give my word. Pay half now to the number I messaged and half later.
We can supply 600 cans at the quoted rate and deliver in six days to all five cities.
Our trade licence number is attached. Please verify it with the district office if you like.
The price holds until Friday evening. Payment will go through the held deal on the platform.
Delivery will be in two trucks because of the volume. One goes to Pune and the other to Chennai.
If the group reaches 1,000 cans we can drop the rate by a few cents. Let me know the final count.
We pack in cartons of 24. Cans are best before next March and the batch number will be on each box.
Please send your delivery addresses and a contact person for each shop. We will plan the route.
Thank you for the order. We will confirm the dispatch date once the group approves.
Quality check happens before loading. You are welcome to send someone to inspect the stock.
We accept returns of damaged cartons within three days of delivery with photos as proof.
Our warehouse closes at six, so loading will start at nine in the morning.
The quoted rate includes transport and taxes. There are no other charges on our side.
We can offer net thirty terms for repeat buyers after the first delivery goes well.
Happy to wait for the whole group to approve. There is no deadline on our side this week.
Aapka order 600 cans ka hai, rate wahi rahega jo quote kiya. Delivery paanch din me hogi.
Platform ke through hi payment hoga, humein koi advance nahi chahiye. Delivery ke baad paisa release hoga.
Humare paas licence aur GST number hai, aap check kar sakte ho. Koi jaldi nahi hai.
The cans are 330 ml and the case size is 24. We can mix flavours in one pallet.
Please confirm the quantity per shop so that we can label the cartons correctly.
Our driver will call the shop owner an hour before arrival. Someone should be present to count.
We have enough stock for the full order, so there is no need to rush your decision.
If any carton is dented we will replace it on the next trip at no cost.
I have shared the invoice template in the chat. It will be filled once delivery is done.
Rates are valid for the quantity in the quote. A smaller order would be priced at the lower tier.
The shipment leaves our depot on Monday and reaches Hyderabad on Wednesday.
We understand the group wants to hold funds until delivery and that is fine with us.
Can you tell me whether Ludhiana needs a separate invoice? We can issue one per shop.
Our customer care line is open nine to six on weekdays if any shop has a question.
We were happy to quote this early. Take your time, the group can discuss it first.
The expiry date is printed on the base of each can and on the carton label.
